idea-plugin.name: Hiberbee Theme Island
idea-plugin.description:
The original Hiberbee Theme plugin has not been updated since 2024: it targets IntelliJ 2024.1 and the legacy UI. The original plugin is still available on JetBrains Marketplace.

This plugin is a continuation of the same theme, updated for the current platform while keeping the original color identity:

  • Built for the Islands theme, the default look of IntelliJ-based IDEs since 2025.3
  • Rounded island areas, borderless sidebars and reworked selected tab colors
  • Rebuilt against IntelliJ Platform 2025.3 with the IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin 2.x
  • Requires IntelliJ-based IDE 2025.3 (build 253) or newer
